why: Both proposals share the same ash desk, birch glass-door bookcase, bentwood rocker and swing-arm lamp, so the chair decides it. A's chair is padded and comfortable, but its honey-toned wood and traditional shape clash with the pale Nordic set and it is bulky (71 cm) at a 118 cm desk; B's birch bentwood swivel chair matches the light-wood Nordic look, though it is less cushioned.
